exact_statement: For every Boolean h on a finite uniform control cube, with b=E h, let F_h=((1+h)/2)y0+((1-h)/2)y1 for independent fresh fair data signs. For any prescribed finite adaptive fresh-control restriction tree T with constant h leaves, followed by the remaining dictator queries, define Q_C=[D-Cd+E Q_child]_+ with zero specified terminal reserve and C>=0. Set A(b)=phi((1+b)^2/4)+phi((1-b)^2/4)+1-b^2-phi(b^2)/2, phi(p)=p log2(1/p). At every control history H(F_h)=H(h)/2+A(b), control query influence d_F=d_h/2, and D_F=D_h/2+A(b)-E A(child mean). The function A lies in [0,2] and is 4-Lipschitz. Consequently [Q_C(h,T)/2+A(b)-2]_+<=Q_C(F_h,T_control-first)<=Q_C(h,T)/2+A(b), and Q_(C+8)(F_h,T_control-first)<=Q_C(h,T)/2. For balanced h the same-price reserve lies between Q_C(h,T)/2 and Q_C(h,T)/2+2. The upper additive two is attained for h a dictator and C=0. The two-state rarity release does not by itself pay the control erasure: on that dictator query it releases1 while D_F=2 and D_h=0. All actual stopping terminal entropies are retained; no intrinsic controller reserve bound is asserted.
hypotheses: Boolean sign outputs; uniform finite cubes; entropies in bits
Two independent fresh dictator data cores, disjoint from the control cube
C>=0; prescribed finite adaptive fresh-coordinate controller policy, constant h leaves, controls before data
Least nonnegative Bellman reserve at zero terminal potential; actual terminal entropy is accounted separately
